text: It just came out four hours ago about women infidelity. Take a guess of what percentage of women cheat in a relationship that's 90 days old. From date number one all the way till day 90, you guessed it, and nope, it wasn't 5%, it was 100%. And that's a crazy study. 500 participants, literally 100%. I thought it was trolling. I just kept reading the study and I was like, huh, I knew it. Yes, guys, I have seen how many of you sent me this video or tagged me under it. And honestly, it genuinely makes me happy that so many of my viewers are actually thinking critically and questioning the information that comes their way. I'm proud that I can perhaps be a very small reason why more and more people stop and ask, wait, is this actually true? And that should apply to everything, whether the claim is about men, women, the left, the right, or anything in between. Because here we apparently have another guy mentioning a study or statistic that I simply cannot find anywhere. I tried searching for any research that would support his claim. Around 500 participants, women in relationships that were 90 days old, supposedly 100% of them cheating. Nothing, no paper, no authors, no journal, no DOI, nothing I could find that even comes close to supporting that claim. And you know what actually amazes me? How lazy this is. Usually this information takes at least a little bit of effort. People find the real study and misrepresent it. They take a statistic out of context, they misunderstand the methodology, they exaggerate what the researchers actually found. Then occasionally you get someone using a completely fabricated study, which is obviously ridiculous, but at least somebody went through the trouble of creating something that looks like a study. And now apparently we have reached the next level. There's actually a Russian saying that I really like. If translated, it would sound something like, we thought we had hit a rock bottom, then somebody knocked from below. Yeah, why bother finding a study at all? Just say a study came out four hours ago, 500 participants, 100% of women cheated. A source peer-reviewed, trust me, bro. And yes, unsurprisingly, there are still guys in the comments going something like, I knew it, as if a random man saying 100% into a camera counts as scientific evidence. But what actually surprised me was how many people call him out on his BS. A lot of you immediately thought, 100%? That sounds suspicious. You tried to find the study, you asked for a source, and many of you tagged me because you wanted someone to actually check it. So again, I am proud of you. Question claims you disagree with, but even more importantly, question claims that tell you exactly what you already want to believe. If more and more of us do that, maybe there's still hope after all.
